project_metadata.description: A synthesized domain model for an e-commerce platform, integrating various bounded contexts.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages user authentication, authorization, and core user profiles across the system.

entities.name: User
entities.description: Represents a registered individual with access credentials and profile information.

value_objects.name: ContactInformation
value_objects.description: Details for reaching a user, such as email and phone number.

value_objects.name: PasswordHash
value_objects.description: Securely stored representation of a user's password.

bounded_contexts.description: Defines the authoritative source for product information, categories, and their core attributes.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: A distinct item available for sale, including its core descriptive and pricing details.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A classification label used to group similar products.

value_objects.name: Price
value_objects.description: The monetary value and currency of a product.

value_objects.name: ProductDescription
value_objects.description: Detailed textual content describing a product.

bounded_contexts.description: Provides functionality for sellers to list, update, and manage the details and images of their products.

entities.name: ProductImage
entities.description: A visual representation associated with a product listing.

bounded_contexts.description: Orchestrates the process of making and accepting offers between buyers and sellers for specific products.

entities.name: Deal
entities.description: A specific instance of a negotiation process for a product between a buyer and a seller.

entities.name: Offer
entities.description: A proposed monetary amount made by a party within a deal negotiation.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: A monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: NegotiationMessage
value_objects.description: A communication exchanged between parties during a deal negotiation.
